As you walked along the ruined city, you made care not to attract attention to yourself. It has been 5 years since The Consortium began their attacks and began taking women to be raped and bred against their will. Thankfully, the store was large enough to hide yourself in whenever a Consortium patrol passed by, but over time, your food stores have begun to dwindle and for the past few weeks, you've been venturing outside of the sanctuary you've made for yourself In an effort to survive. As The Consortium occupies more and more of the city, patrols have become more and more frequent. 

Stepping outside once again, you are on the hunt for food to survive. As shouts and battles rage in the distance, you creep down the streets in an effort to find a place to scavenge. At the end of the street, you see a corner store that looked to be completely intact. There was no telling if there was any food to be had inside, but it was worth a shot to check. 

As you approach the corner store however, a Consortium patrol begins to make their way towards your direction behind you, blocking your way back home.
